findings.issue: Terminal receipt lookup does not bind original operation/method to admitted HTTP status and result schema/tag. Hash-consistent but semantically incompatible tuples are accepted as HISTORICAL_MODEL_MATCH_NOT_PERMISSION.
reproductions: OPEN_CONNECTION POST + COMPLETED +204 empty body accepted
findings.impact: Contradicts protocol201OPENED and UNKNOWN-unresolved-only rules. Hash/link equality cannot establish a definitive valid original outcome; future consumers must not adopt these model successes as qualified receipt reconciliation. No real runtime exploitation claimed.
findings.required_change: Pin explicit operation/state/status/result-definition matrix and enforce it before model match. Reject UNKNOWN as a terminal receipt, wrong result/status/operation pairs and malformed conflicting outcomes. Add negative vectors including OPEN204, UNKNOWN201, ERROR201, wrong result operation and DELETE201; retain valid definitive409 error and empty204 ACK/closed cases.
